exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean delivery vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: Milk fat globule membrane protein (MFGMP) composition
Differentially expressed proteins (DEP) in human MFGMP
cohort: Chinese women providing mature human milk, categorized by parity, maternal age, and mode of delivery.
finding: Variations in MFGMP composition were found between different cohorts, with differentially expressed proteins related to innate immune response in multiparous women and to inflammatory and innate immune response in women with different delivery modes.
mod_finding: Differentially expressed proteins in human milk fat globule membrane of women with different delivery modes were primarily related to inflammatory and innate immune response, with an upregulation of defense response-related DEP found in the milk of women who had cesarean delivery.
